dataset: Microsoft FinOps Toolkit demo FOCUS dataset
interpretation: This is an evidence availability assessment, not an SLA compliance test. A matching field name is not sufficient to verify measurement meaning, units, provenance, contractual targets or compliance.
limitations: Billing charges and billing-period dates are not operational SLA measurements.
No compliance percentage is calculated without validated observations and targets.
Service-level statuses remain NOT_VERIFIABLE unless sufficient validated evidence is supplied.
Before optimizing a production FinTech service, validate uptime, latency, error rates, workload, resource utilization, contractual targets and rollback procedures.
